Multi-implicit peer-W uses stage-specific shifts and remains stage-parallel in its selected subclass.
Published local/global error control exists for linearly implicit parallel two-step peer-W; exact method-matched estimator transcription is required.
SEPP order 2/3/4 TASE-stabilized peer methods; the paper's reported examples are sequential, so native speedup is not established.

Variable-step diagonally implicit L(alpha)-stable peer methods have norm-estimate results through order five; treat as high-order stiff comparator, not parallel by default.

mathematical_checks.claim: For an 8x8 strict-lower triangular N, N^8=0 and (I-lambda N)^-1=sum(k=0..7)(lambda N)^k.
mathematical_checks.basis: nilpotency of strict lower triangular matrices and finite geometric series

mathematical_checks.claim: The binary composition (I+lambda N)(I+lambda^2 N^2)(I+lambda^4 N^4) equals the finite inverse when N^8=0.
Wolfram exact symbolic witness on a generic bidiagonal 8x8 nilpotent shift returned N^8=0, finite-inverse residual zero and binary-factorization residual zero.
mathematical_checks.limitation: This is a witness/check of the algebraic implementation; the general claim follows from the nilpotency derivation. Neither result implies a runtime speedup.
